rationale: All source families are covered. Non-linearMGF means the four base sub-Gaussian characterizations, not an omission of centered variables. The universal square gauge theorem includes arbitrary Gaussian squares. The target follows the displayed variance, fixes the otherwise unspecified exponential psi_1 constant to 2, and includes zero-rate Poisson. Thus Lean implies the source, while the source does not imply these exact and broader claims: faithful-stronger, accepted, with no unresolved item.
